groups.saying_opens: لا يزال أمر الناس ماضيا ما وليهم

notes: Two sayings, each with its own isnad: «سمعت النبي» (the first) and «فسألت أبي ماذا قال رسول الله» (the second, Jabir asking his father).
The second group keeps the head down to Jabir and then the father, a bare relation (rule 7).
The «كلمة خفيت» Jabir did not hear is the second saying's content, not a link.
